states.name: out_reg
states.meaning: 32-bit capture register; each bit remains 1 after a detected 1-to-0 input transition until cleared by synchronous reset.
states.update_time: posedge clk after sampling reset and in

states.name: prev_in
states.meaning: 32-bit previous sampled input value used to detect 1-to-0 transitions between successive cycles.

rules.condition: reset == 1 at the sampled posedge; out becomes 0
reset == 0 at the sampled posedge; for every bit i, out_next[i] = out[i] OR (prev_in[i] AND (in[i] == 0)); bits already set remain 1
rules.spec_quote: capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: first sampled posedge with reset == 0; normal falling-edge capture and hold apply on that edge

mid: Optional mid object supplies changed nonclock inputs after the sampled posedge; those changes are carried to the start of the next row as pre-edge input values.

uncertain.note: The specification does not explicitly state whether the previous-input history is reset or still updated during synchronous reset. This contract assumes prev_in updates on every posedge, including reset cycles.
candidates: prev_in updates during reset, so a 1-to-0 transition can be captured on the first released posedge
prev_in is cleared or not updated during reset, so a transition spanning the reset interval is not captured

falling_edge_capture_and_hold: prev_in updates during reset, so a 1-to-0 transition can be captured on the first released posedge
prev_in is cleared or not updated during reset, so a transition spanning the reset interval is not captured
prev_in is cleared or not updated during reset, so a pre-reset 1 followed by 0 on the first released cycle is not captured and out stays 0.
